notes: Extracted via WebFetch (model-mediated) asking for verbatim text, scale by scale. On the page '+ keyed', '– keyed' and 'Omitted' act as group headers: items listed after 'Omitted' are not part of the scored scale. Under that reading every scale's scored item count equals the stated count (checked: stated_items == len(items)). Source typos preserved (e.g. 'Don't act is if I'm a special person.'). Apostrophes may be normalized to ASCII except where the extraction returned a curly one.
